title: Red Wine and Mushroom Risotto
subtitle: with fresh porcini
description: A rich arborio risotto made with red wine and a generous amount of butter-sauteed porcini mushrooms, finished with parmesan.

steps.text: Slice the mushrooms thinly and fry in a pan with 100 g of the butter until soft.

Chop the shallot and fry it separately in a medium pot with 1 tbsp butter. When golden, add the rice and stir over low heat for about 3 minutes. Add the wine and continue cooking until completely evaporated.
Add the hot stock gradually, stirring, adding more once the previous amount has been absorbed. Continue cooking and stirring for about 15 minutes until the rice softens.
Remove from the heat and add the mushrooms, the remaining butter and the cheese. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
